long_description:
A modern solution for Startup legal.

Vector combines premier lawyers/paralegals (averaging 10+ years of Big Law experience) + custom-built AI, so our clients get world class startup legal service at a fraction of Big Law rates. See our client testimonials - https://www.vectorlegal.com/testimonials.

Services: fundraise & priced rounds | customer contracts | international flips | complex formations | grow your team | agentic data rooms | e-signatures | cap table management | legal health checks | mergers & acquisitions | co-founder separations | dissolutions.
